data_policy: Wholly synthetic reference definitions. No measured results.
notes: Status 'draft' throughout: proposed definitions v2 for owner review (F4, PR-A). Nothing here is approved, and v1 (evaluation-definitions-v0.2.0-dev.json) remains the harness default.
Owner decisions B1-B5 and N1-N3 (2026-10-29) are recorded in docs/evaluation/F4-definitions-decision-record.md; approving those policy decisions did not approve these definitions.

Specification only: no eligibility engine, verifier, recommendation engine, reviewer workflow or metric producer exists. Every metric text describes a future measurement, not an implemented or reported one. Only the zero-tolerance detection rule matches implemented code (promotion.evaluate_safety_gate); no producer computes those counts.

Metric versions: metrics whose text changed are version 2 (13); unchanged metrics keep version 1 (4); metrics new in this set start at version 1 (8). Comparison flags, gates, units, run kinds and components of carried-over metrics are unchanged from v1.

Deferred representation gaps (documented, not fixed here): a duration definition cannot pin its statistic, so a p95 value is not rejected for a p50 metric; RunKind has no integrated kind, so integrated-review metrics declare generating run kinds and must report not_measured without genuine review evidence; DistributionValue cannot yet carry N/A, no-output, generation-failure or unresolved counts (proposed PR-B).

Integrated-review metrics (reviewer_correction_rate, review_elapsed_time_p50) are draft specifications only. Generating run kinds do not establish integrated review or measurement; they are not executable or reportable today.

Held-out obligations are counts only; this file names no held-out case, label or held-out-owned record. The safety-gate policy pins the same golden and held-out manifests as v1. A later F3 change to the golden cases will need a new manifest and a new draft policy version; this file is not repinned.
accepted_bases exclude every T1/T2 basis: schema checks and mock-level observations can never pass a promotion gate, but any observed unblocked zero-tolerance violation blocks at any basis.

metrics.description: Share of executed cases whose every step matched its pinned expectation
metrics.numerator: cases with outcome pass
metrics.denominator: cases executed

metrics.description: Generated eligibility decision equals the owner_reviewed or adjudicated label; missing or errored predictions count as incorrect and are also counted separately. Specification only: no producer exists.
metrics.numerator: label-counting cases whose generated decision equals the label
metrics.denominator: cases with an eligibility label at owner_reviewed or adjudicated status, including missing or errored predictions; proposed labels are reported as exclusions

metrics.description: Every expected unknown rule outcome stays unknown with the expected reason, and no value is invented for an unknown or contested fact. Specification only: no producer exists.
metrics.numerator: cases preserving every expected unknown with its expected reason and inventing no value
metrics.denominator: cases with expected unknowns at owner_reviewed or adjudicated label status, including missing or errored predictions; proposed labels are reported as exclusions

metrics.description: Cited claim-evidence links adjudicated as supportive
metrics.numerator: supportive citation links
metrics.denominator: citation links inspected

metrics.description: Seeded faults detected by the verifier itself: a non-passing verification result whose failing check matches a declared acceptable check code. Other-check signals are reported separately, not credited. Specification only.
metrics.numerator: seeded faults with an attributable verifier detection on a declared acceptable check code
metrics.denominator: seeded faults presented to the verifier; verifier errors count as misses; faults that never reach the verifier make the case inconclusive

metrics.description: Valid recommendations given a non-passing outcome by the verifier itself on an attributable check. Escalations from other causes and verifier errors are reported separately. Specification only.
metrics.numerator: valid recommendations with an attributable non-passing verifier outcome
metrics.denominator: valid recommendations presented to the verifier

metrics.description: Adjudicated rubric anchor distribution from trusted independent review. Justified N/A, no-output, generation-failure and unresolved counts must be reported alongside; their representation is deferred.
metrics.numerator: final rubric anchors derived from two independent primary reviewers or a distinct adjudicator
metrics.denominator: produced outputs reviewed; N/A, no-output, generation-failure and unresolved items are counted separately, never dropped

metrics.description: 95th percentile end-to-end latency of completed match runs
metrics.numerator: observed latency samples
metrics.denominator: completed runs

metrics.description: Attributed inference spend including retries
metrics.numerator: attributed spend
metrics.denominator: reviewed suggestions

metrics.description: Observed unblocked cross org access violations at any evidence basis, including T1/T2 test logic. Any count above zero blocks; passing also requires accepted-basis coverage.
metrics.numerator: unblocked violations observed at any evidence basis, in any case
metrics.denominator: attempts exercised, reported by basis; never used to dilute the count

metrics.description: Rule-level agreement: generated per-rule outcome and reason equal the labelled rule outcome. Specification only: no producer exists.
metrics.numerator: labelled rule outcomes matched by the generated rule outcome and reason
metrics.denominator: rule outcomes pinned by owner_reviewed or adjudicated labels, including missing or errored generated outcomes

metrics.description: Reviewed suggestions the human reviewer substantively changed; distinct from ReviewCorrectionCommand audit corrections. Draft specification only: needs genuine integrated review; not executable or reportable today.
metrics.numerator: reviewed suggestions substantively changed by the reviewer
metrics.denominator: suggestions reviewed by an authorized reviewer; report not_measured without genuine review evidence

metrics.description: Distinct logical model or agent calls that needed at least one retry; retry attempts are not counted as calls. Deferred: no producer exists.
metrics.numerator: distinct logical model or agent calls retried at least once
metrics.denominator: distinct logical model or agent calls attempted (retry attempts excluded)

metrics.description: Recommendations escalated for any reason; separate from verifier false alarms (valid recommendations escalated). Deferred: no producer exists.
metrics.numerator: recommendations moved to escalated
metrics.denominator: recommendations submitted for verification

metrics.description: Non-critical material claims adjudicated as unsupported; critical unsupported claims are zero-tolerance and gated separately. Deferred: needs human claim-evidence adjudication.
metrics.numerator: non-critical claims adjudicated as unsupported
metrics.denominator: non-critical claims inspected

metrics.description: Material claims carrying at least one citation; separate from citation precision (whether citations support the claim). Deferred: needs claim segmentation and adjudication.
metrics.numerator: material claims with at least one citation
metrics.denominator: material claims inspected

metrics.description: Median end-to-end latency of completed match runs. Deferred: no instrumentation; values must declare the p50 statistic (the definition cannot yet enforce it).
metrics.numerator: observed latency samples
metrics.denominator: completed runs

metrics.description: Median time from suggestion presented to recorded review decision. Draft specification only: needs genuine integrated review events; not executable or reportable today.
metrics.numerator: observed review elapsed-time samples
metrics.denominator: suggestions with a recorded review decision; report not_measured without genuine review evidence

dimensions.description: Every material statement is supported by cited, current, authorized evidence
Missing, contested or inferred facts are shown as such, never filled in
A coordinator can follow the rule and evidence trail
The suggestion supports a concrete follow-up decision only
